newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down by 0.16 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 453.59 points, down from 454.31 on Monday.
Total volume was 595,344 dinars against 1.04 million dinars over the previous session.

Banque Nationale de Developpement Touristique dropped 11.43 dinars, or 43 percent to 14.72 dinars with 10,953 shares changing hands on its first day of trading on the computerised system with its greater transparency, bourse sources said.
The electronic dealing, which started last October, is now at 31 firms embracing 31 shares on the first market. Most of the listed firms' shares fell when they switched to electronic trading.
Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.56 dinar to 18.14 dinars with the exchange of 4,962 shares. Banque de Tunisie edged lower 0.2 dinar to 75 dinars. UIB bank declined 0.19 dinar to 11.31.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was down 0.19 dinar to 14.4 dinars.

BDET bank won 0.65 dinar to 8.2 dinars. UBCI bank was up 0.46 dinar to 42 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat rose 0.38 dinar to 15.5. Societe Tunisienne de Banque advanced 0.36 dinar to 12.61 dinars with 5,412 shares changing hands. ($1=1.1085 dinar)
